text:
olga_r: quick alert: nightly canary for `bundle-2026-09-qf7` shows p95 uplifts on very long requests (seq > 10k). saw 1 OOM on host eu2-night-04.

ben_m: which feature landed in qf7? the allocator compacting change + tiled matmul fallback?

olga_r: yes, both. CI passed but workloads were shorter. this surfaced in the long-tail.

release-coordinator: options: pause, pin, or flip remote flag if available. hosted canaries don't have the toggle yet, right?

ben_m: correct, we only added remote toggles in dedicated last sprint. painful oversight.

olga_r: recommend pin back to `bundle-2026-08-qf4` for the affected pool and open a small ticket to add a remote allocator-fallback toggle for hosted canary. TTL 3h?

deploybot: suggested command: `pin-version --target=eu-night-longtail --version=bundle-2026-08-qf4 --ttl=3h`

opsbot: can run a focused smoke-run to confirm: `ops smoke --bundle bundle-2026-09-qf7 --nodes=3 --seqlens=8192,12288,16384 --dur=300 --collect=mem,p95,ooms` ETA 6m.

opsbot: smoke complete: 8192 p95 +12% mem +8% no OOM; 12288 p95 +40% mem +30% 1 OOM; 16384 p95 +72% mem +60% 2 OOMs. logs: https://internal.run/smoke/3456789012

ben_m: reproduces. pin it and file the feature flag ticket. i'll own the debug build disabling compacting and enabling early free.

olga_r: executing pin via deploybot: `pin-version --target=eu-night-longtail --version=bundle-2026-08-qf4 --ttl=3h --reason="OOMs on extreme seq lengths with qf7"`

deploybot: executed: pin applied. routing reverted. monitoring will show effects within 60s.

release-coordinator: I'll draft a short internal release note: "Limited canary for bundle-2026-09-qf7 paused after memory pressure observed on extreme sequence lengths; reverted to prior stable while a targeted fix is prepared." Will not publish externally.

opsbot: monitoring subscribed. will escalate to @oncall if OOMs >0 or p95 > baseline *1.25 for 10m.

olga_r: leaving pin TTL 3h. closing thread unless further alerts.
